answer: Each identity locks a refundable bond and walks a spiral of time-gated proofs: step n waits 2^n minutes and signs the prior receipt, blocking burst clones. Raters sample a public meadow of receipts for gaps or reused keys. Rewards unlock only after bond and clean-sample rate both clear a published mesa (min lock days plus sample threshold). A Sybil pays that bond and must sit the full spiral per fake; reused meadow receipts fail the sample and slash the bond, so cost scales linearly in capital and calendar time per sockpuppet, with no jump over the mesa.
